Sara — thanks for sending these. We can absolutely close this week. Quick proposal below so Novaplus and Redwood are aligned: 

- Use a single DocuSign envelope with two sequential signing groups: (1) Redwood MSA signer(s) then (2) Novaplus signatory. The Order Form will be attached to the same envelope and set to sign immediately after MSA countersignature.
- Primary Redwood signer for MSA: Ben Carter (VP, Legal Ops) — backing from Legal Counsel as needed. If Ben is out, Laura Bennett (Director, Contracts) is the delegate.
- We'll provide a final clean copy PDF (both docs combined) and a summary CSV with envelope fields for audit.

I can mirror this plan in the envelope name: "Novaplus — Redwood MSA + Order Form — DEAL-11284". If Tom prefers separate envelopes for practical reasons, we can split, but single envelope reduces execution friction and audit complexity.

I penciled Ben into the signing lane; Ben, can you confirm your availability tomorrow to sign?

Regards,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Manager, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (650) 555-0199
